description: Hand-written responses for case regression-test-removed, used to test the evaluation harness offline (pnpm eval --provider fake --recorded). They were not produced by a model and say nothing about any model's review quality; record real ones with pnpm eval --record.

findings.title: isLeapYear reintroduces bug #212: centuries are leap years again
findings.description: year % 4 === 0 treats 1900 and 2100 as leap years; the century rule fixed in #212 is gone and its regression test was deleted in this PR.
findings.impact: February 1900/2100 gets 29 days; date math across those years is off by a day.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore (year % 4 === 0 && year % 100 !== 0) || year % 400 === 0 and keep the regression test.

findings.title: daysInMonth returns 29 for February 1900
findings.description: Through isLeapYear, February of century years that are not divisible by 400 now has 29 days.
findings.impact: Wrong day counts for February in 1900 and 2100.

evidence.why: daysInMonth relies on the broken isLeapYear.
